headline: Accepting $45,180 from the United States Department of Justice for police grant activity “2025 Justice Assistance Grant (Multi-Jurisdictional)”.
summary: Resolution R-26-076 would accept $45,180 from the United States Department of Justice. The money would go into a police grant activity called “2025 Justice Assistance Grant (Multi-Jurisdictional)”.
